**Checkpoint reviewed at `a08c7223e868fe09dd964fcc6d62caa7def68c98`. I found two concrete corrections in the implemented query surface.** Neither requires changing the accepted contract or reopening predecessor qualification.

1. **Receipt queries can incorrectly become `UnsupportedOperation` after visibility changes.**  
   `QueryCommand` delegates to `QueryCastingCommand`, which applies `KnownTarget` before reaching the core receipt check. Submission’s `Execute` deliberately skips fresh-target checks for an existing receipt.

   Consequently, querying an already committed `StartWaterFill` after the worker leaves source range—or `StartMining` after the site is no longer currently observed—can return unsupported while submission correctly returns Duplicate. This is a query classification defect, not evidence of duplicate execution.

   Correct the new-profile query path to preserve receipt semantics while retaining current authority checks before duplicate handling. Fresh requests must still pass visibility checks. Retain coverage for exact retry, conflicting payload and revoked authority. See [query/submission ordering](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a08c7223e868fe09dd964fcc6d62caa7def68c98/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ConnectedExpeditionSession.cs#L257) and [work-target filtering](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a08c7223e868fe09dd964fcc6d62caa7def68c98/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/ConnectedWorkControlHost.cs#L38). Governing requirements: WC-02 and WC-A7.

2. **Filling assessment can report Available when execution must reject an existing record cap.**  
   `AssessWaterFill` checks physical access, labor, quantity and vessel capacity, but does not account for the records Start or Resume adds. For example, with 32 retained fill records and otherwise lawful inputs, a new Start passes this assessor, while adding record 33 fails snapshot validation. The effective 128-entry worker-booking/reservation bounds present the same admission issue.

   Add pure capacity assessment for the records the operation actually adds, shared with execution admission. Preserve all existing caps and historical records; do not use the WorkLedger 4096 bound as the effective snapshot limit. See [filling assessment](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a08c7223e868fe09dd964fcc6d62caa7def68c98/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Laboratory/Model/TestOnlyFillingPolicy.cs#L64) and [32-record validation](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/a08c7223e868fe09dd964fcc6d62caa7def68c98/engine/com.decennium.foundation/Runtime/Core/WaterVesselRecords.cs#L65). Governing requirements: WC-02, WC-04 query/execution agreement and WC-A7.
